facts.population_meaning: each cell holds the mean elevation of the finer-grid nodes inside it and the largest of their uncertainties; a cell with no node is empty; nothing is interpolated

layers_read: the finer grids, resampled to 8 m cells (elevation and uncertainty)
read_from: the held product's own metadata; not recomputable from the subset

resampling_check.method: every node of every finer grid is put in the cell its position falls in; each cell's mean elevation and largest uncertainty are recomputed and must match the resampled grid to 1 mm, and a cell with no node must be empty there; a node exactly on a cell edge may fall on either side, and such cells are counted apart
